sloka: ततो अस्य सशरम् चापम् मुक्ता मणि विभूषितम् ।चरणाभ्याम् महातेजा बभंज पतगोत्तमः ॥३-५१-१०॥
transliteration: tato asya saśaram cāpam muktā maṇi vibhūṣitam ।caraṇābhyām mahātejā babhaṁja patagottamaḥ ॥3-51-10॥

translations.english: Seeing Sita, daughter of Janaka, on the demon's chariot with eyes full of tears, Jatayu without minding the arrows renewed his attack.
